analysis.summary: During the financial year ended March 31, 2025, Uday Jewellery Industries Limited delivered robust financial performance with total revenue increasing by 65.84% to ₹28,720.20 lakh and profit after tax rising by 24.70% to ₹1,086.64 lakh, driven by higher sales volumes across domestic and export markets. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansion at its Hyderabad facility from 20 kg/month to 125 kg/month and a proposed scheme of arrangement to amalgamate Narbada Gems & Jewellery Limited. The company continues to employ disciplined risk management practices, including hedging and Gold Metal Loans, to mitigate commodity price volatility. Uday Jewellery Industries Ltd. specializes in the manufacture and trade of gold jewellery studded with Cubic Zirconia and other precious stones, operating primarily in the B2B segment alongside plans to extend into the B2C segment through asset-light routes.

demand_outlook.claim: India is the largest consumer of gold in the world, propelled by rising disposable incomes and rapid urbanization.
demand_outlook.quote: India is the largest consumer of gold in the world, the sector being propelled by favourable macro trends including rising disposable income levels and rapid urbanization.

demand_outlook.claim: The size of the Indian gems and jewellery market is expected to reach approximately USD 103 billion by 2023.
demand_outlook.quote: It is estimated that Its market size will grow to USD 103.06 billion by 2023..

demand_outlook.claim: The year started well with successful Akshaya Thrithiyai sales supported by higher realization from steep gold price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: The year 2023-24 started well with the resounding success on “Akshaya Thrithiyai” sales that fell in the first quarter that already supported by better realization due to steep increase in gold price movement.

capex_expansion.claim: A second unit comprising 10,000 square feet of space is expected to be in operation by August 2021.
capex_expansion.quote: A second unit comprising 10,000 sq. feet of space is expected to be in operation by August 2021.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is coming up with new facilities expanding its capacity to four times the existing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: With a target of becoming the largest manufacturer of CZ with precious colour gemstones studded jewellery, the company is coming up with new facilities with an expansion of its capacity 4 times than the existing and the said facility of the Company will be well equipped with state-of-the-art Mechanization and technology thereby increasing the overall capacity and enhanced finishing of the products.

margins_costs.claim: The average cost of debt for the company works out to less than 9% for FY20.
margins_costs.quote: But the cost of capital has been under control at all times (average cost of debt works out to less than 9% for FY20).

margins_costs.claim: Gold can be availed via Gold Metal Loans at an interest rate of 4% per annum.
margins_costs.quote: This allows the Company to procure gold for a period of up to 180 days at an interest rate of 4% p.a.

margins_costs.claim: Gold input attracts an import duty of 7.5% following a reduction from 12.5% in the FY22 Union Budget.
margins_costs.quote: At present gold attracts an import duty of 7.5% (reduced from 12.5% in the FY22 Union Budget).

orders_capacity.claim: Uday Jewellery Industries operates from a 4,000 square foot workshop situated in Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company‟s operations are based at a 4,000 sq. foot workshop situated in Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: The inventory turnover of the company has been around 4x to 5x over the last 5 years.
orders_capacity.quote: UJIL‟s Inventory Turnover has been around 4x – 5x over the last 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company enjoys a cash credit limit of INR 150 million from Kotak Mahindra Bank.
capital_allocation.quote: UJIL enjoys a cash credit limit of INR 150 Million from Kotak Mahindra Bank.

capital_allocation.claim: Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the year under review to conserve resources for further business expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for further expanding business of the Company, your directors have opined not to recommend any dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is planning for a further issue of capital through up to 25,00,000 convertible warrants.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company is planning for a further issue of capital by issue and allotment of upto 25,00,000 Warrants convertible into Equity shares.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global jewellery sector continues to navigate a complex environment marked by fluctuating commodity prices, shifting consumer preferences, and economic headwinds in key markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global jewellery sector continues to navigate a complex environment marked by fluctuating commodity prices, shifting consumer preferences, and economic headwinds in key markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposed transactions with Narbada Gems and Jewellery Limited and Sanghi Jewellers Private Limited for a period of 12 months starting from October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Hence, approval of the shareholders is being sought for the said Related Party Transactions proposed to be entered into by your Company with Narbada Gems and Jewellery Limited (NGJL) and Sanghi Jewellers Private Limited (SJPL) for a period of 12 months starting from 01st October 2025 to 30th September 2026

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
